data_fields.name: cap_base
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 + depth % 5 + Random.Int(3), re-rolled on every read

data_fields.name: place_tries
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 outer tries, each up to 30 random cells

data_fields.name: respawn_mining_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 x base on the mining level

data_fields.name: spawn_weight_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per mob (Ghoul overrides to 0.5, Mimic to 0)

best_idea: A per-zone director that on each timer step counts live enemies (weighted), compares with a cap, places at most one new enemy at a distance from the players and outside their view, and reschedules itself: a short retry on failure, a longer cooldown on success.
decision_why: The cap, check, place, reschedule shape fits zone population (row 23), but the donor is single-hero, turn-based and never despawns, so we take the shape only: cap and timings become zone data, the cap is rolled once per respawn cycle (the donor re-rolls it on every read), and a failed placement does not consume the next kind.
acceptance: A server test with two players in a zone with cap 6 and respawn 50 s: with 6 enemies alive nothing spawns; with 5 alive, one spawn occurs after the cooldown, at path distance of at least 12 tiles from both players and outside each player's line of sight; a failed placement retries after 1 s and leaves the zone's next kind unused.
